title: 3SAT verifier certificates
statement: For every finite Boolean word $x$, its decoded formula has width at most three and is satisfiable if and only if there is a Boolean word $u$ of length $|x|+1$ such that the verifier in 3SAT mode accepts the concatenation of $x$ and $u$.
replaced:
A binary string $x$ belongs to $\mathrm{3SAT}$ if and only if there exists a
certificate $u$ with $|u| = |x| + 1$ such that $x \mathbin{+\!\!+} u$ belongs to the
3SAT-mode verifier language. The width condition depends only on the instance $x$,
so the same certificate as for $\mathrm{SAT}$ suffices.
